summary: Shares of India’s Tata Group companies wiped out 433 billion rupees ($4.5 billion) in market value Wednesday after Chairman Natarajan Chandrasekaran said he will step down when his term ends in February, deepening a leadership crisis.

title: Norway's Sovereign Wealth Fund CEO Eyes Future Risks
summary: Nicolai Tangen, CEO of Norway's $2.3 trillion sovereign wealth fund, tells Bloomberg he is cautious on future risks including AI valuations, inflation and geopolitical conflict, despite record results. Norges Bank Investment Management reported its best quarterly earnings for six years, with half-year returns exceeding 9%, gaining approximately $185 billion. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Trump Claims Hormuz Control, US CPI Data on Deck | The Opening Trade 8/12/2026
summary:
President Donald Trump claimed the US had “total control over the Hormuz Strait,” as Washington and Tehran hardened their stances in deadlocked negotiations over the waterway.
“We own it,” Trump told reporters at Joint Base Andrews outside Washington late Tuesday. “And at some point, maybe they’ll do something, and then they get blown away.”

US consumer prices data for July will be in focus as higher oil prices raise concerns that the Federal Reserve will need to hike interest rates. Treasuries steadied with the yield on the benchmark 10-year note little changed.

The Opening Trade has everything you need to know as markets open across Europe. With analysis you won't find anywhere else, we break down the biggest stories of the day and speak to top guests who have skin in the game. Hosted by Anna Edwards, Guy Johnson and Tom Mackenzie. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: China’s Stubborn Commodity Markets Defy Economic Rulebook

title: Citi's Hollenhorst Sees Trend Toward Cooling Inflation
summary: Andrew Hollenhorst, chief US economist at Citi, discusses the outlook for today's US inflation report. "If we get a cool reading again this month, and we think that we will, then you have more of a trend toward cooling inflation," Hollenhorst tells Bloomberg Television. "And that's just a very, very different story than what we've been hearing from some Fed officials." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: MEMX Files to List Prediction Market-Style Bets on Earnings
summary: Exchange operator MEMX is looking to become the latest financial exchange to compete with prediction markets by offering binary bets on corporate earnings metrics, according to a representative for the company.

title: Emerging Stocks Rise on Tech as Currency Traders Await US CPI
summary: Emerging-market stocks rose, led by a rally in Asian chipmakers as upbeat results from AI infrastructure firms revived appetite for tech stocks. Developing-nation currencies were mixed before the publication of US inflation data later in the session.

title: IEA Says Oil Markets Are Facing a Wider Shortfall
summary: Global oil inventories will tumble this quarter at more than twice the rate previously estimated, according to the International Energy Agency. Markets face a shortfall of 1.8 million barrels a day as “renewed hostilities and maritime disruptions” in the Middle East undermine a production recovery, the IEA said in its monthly report. Bloomberg's Anthony di Paola reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Strategist Weighs September Fed Hike Amid Mixed Data
summary:
Laureline Renaud-Chatelain, fixed income strategy lead at Pictet Wealth Management, discussed the likelihood of a Federal Reserve rate hike in September. She noted that the recent payroll data was somewhat surprising but indicated a stable labor market that is not adding inflationary pressure. Despite noisy and downwardly revised employment figures, the key focus remains on upcoming Consumer Price Index (CPI) prints, which will heavily influence the Fed's decision.
